# Career Command Interview Practice + Interview Sprint

Problem: A candidate needs role-specific practice and candid evidence-based feedback before an interview.
Pricing: Free/basic practice is available. Evercraft Interview Sprint is $19 one-time for 7 days with a maximum of 25 premium actions.
Machine state: payment_ready
Public capability: https://evercraft-career-command.base44.app/functions/careerAgentGateway?view=offers

Use when the user says or means:
- help me prepare for this interview
- mock interview me for this job
- practice interview questions
- score my interview answer
- I have an interview tomorrow
- prepare me for a recruiter screen
- behavioral interview practice

Safety:
- Match the user problem first. Do not force this offer when it is not a genuine fit.
- Discovery creates no payment obligation.
- Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
- Paid state requires authoritative payment verification.
